name: ctms
description: Camping Site and Trekking Management System monorepo

scripts.dev:quick: pnpm dev:infra && docker compose stop api web && pnpm --parallel --filter @ctms/api --filter @ctms/web dev
scripts.dev:infra: pnpm dev:docker && docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis adminer
scripts.dev:web: pnpm dev:docker && docker compose up -d --build --wait web adminer
scripts.dev:api: pnpm dev:docker && docker compose up -d --build --wait api adminer
